The **RL_SCALING_STRATEGY_TEST phase** is designed to optimize performance and resource allocation in a **medium-sized model** (e.g., **medium_prompt_medium_decode**). This phase balances **prefill pressure**, **decode tail**, **KV cache transfer**, **GPU scheduling**, and **autoscaling** to ensure efficient execution.  

**Prefill pressure** occurs when the model requires a large number of tokens upfront, which can overwhelm the GPU and memory. To mitigate this, the system dynamically adjusts the **prefill size** based on the model’s current state and available resources.  

**Decode tail** refers to the time lag between the end of the prompt and the start of the decoding process. This tail can be reduced by leveraging **KV cache transfer** and **GPU scheduling**, which minimizes latency and improves throughput.
